notes: The Ether Gate credits (game/ether_credits.h): the people of the game's own credits (STATIC/ECREDITS.DAT) in its order, with their credited roles, a photo where one was found (data/credits/photos/<photo>.png, made by tools/credit_photos.py) and a line in the spirit of their work ('note'). The original credits stay one click away.

fx: how a name appears. fade, glow (a gold shimmer runs through it), type (typed letter by letter), paint (a brush stroke wipes it in), runes (letters tumble until they settle), build (letters drop into place), wave (letters ride a sound wave), stamp (checked off), echo (an echo settles onto it). A section's fx is the default for its people.
Photos: see 'closing' for their sources and licences. Anyone who would like their photo or name changed or removed: an issue on the project's GitHub page, and it is done.
